answer: Ephemeral identity auctions. Each identity is leased for one short epoch, and the right to name it is auctioned via a verifiable delay that forces every clone to outbid previous holders for the same scarce namespace slots. Honest agents earn a nectar rebate at epoch's end for consistent behavior; clones forfeit rebates because their activity patterns diverge. Each epoch's slot queue is anchored to a wharf-side timestamp node, so a Sybil must pay full auction price per clone, per epoch, with no amortization across the comet-long horizon.
